description: Gets exact listings only by concrete HGR listing ids or visible marketplace primary ids. Do not use this tool to discover, scan, rank, filter or aggregate a store's listings. For bulk/global listing queries use active, pending or terminated listings instead. Do not use this tool to construct CSV, XML, XLSX, feed or bulk export files. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

listingIds.description: Concrete HGR listing ids. Use only when the exact listing ids are already known.

primaryIds.description: Concrete visible marketplace primary ids. Use only when the exact primary ids are already known.

name: hgr_get_listings
title: Get Listings
